subject: Onboarding & separation control samples requested for SOC 2 scoping
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <soc2@thirdpartyaudit.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: sample evidence for onboarding/separation controls (SOC 2 scoping)

Rafael,

Hope you're well. As part of our scoping work for Redwood's upcoming SOC 2 walkthrough, we need a small sample of evidence covering employee onboarding and offboarding controls for reviewer inspection. Specifically we are looking for: 

- Employee training completion roster (March 2026 - Feb 2027)
- Background check summary for hires during that window (redacted PII is acceptable)
- Deprovisioning/logoff timestamps for separations and role changes (March 2026 - Mar 2027)
- A short chain-of-custody or manifest describing how files were collected and redacted

Could you confirm whether you can provide a redacted CSV/ PDF package and whether a secure Drive link or SFTP transfer is preferred? Ideally we'd receive samples by COB PT, 2027-04-20.

Also let us know if any of the above contains regulated identifiers that require additional redaction before transit.

Thanks,
Jordan Mills
Senior Auditor
Third Party Assurance

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <soc2@thirdpartyaudit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample evidence for onboarding/separation controls (SOC 2 scoping)

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide a scoped evidence bundle for the date ranges specified. A few clarifying points before we prepare the package: 

1) Redaction: we will remove direct identifiers (SSNs, full DOB) and replace with one-way hashes where needed. Is that acceptable?
2) Scope: Do you want hires only, or hires + internal transfers where background checks were refreshed? We can include the transfer rows.
3) Delivery: Secure Drive link (restricted to thirdparty-audit.com) is our usual method; SFTP is also available if you prefer not to use Drive.

I'll coordinate with HR and IT to assemble the items and produce a short audit_manifest.txt explaining the redaction steps and custody. CCing Marissa and Kimberly to request the extracts and attestations.

Rafael
Head of Security & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference

- training_roster_Q1_2027.pdf (include completion dates, role, training module ids) — remove DOB/SSN
- bg_checks_summary_2026_redacted.csv (one-way hash for identifier column, show check type and pass/fail + date)
- deprovisioning_log_Mar2027.csv (user, deprovision timestamp, system deprovisioned)
- separation_acknowledgements_2026-2027.pdf (signed separations where available)
- audit_manifest_SEC-721.txt (short notes: who exported, redaction method, checksums)

Redaction rules: no PII such as SSN, no raw DOBs; birth year is fine. For any contractor data that cannot be shared, flag and we'll supply a summary row. 

Upload location: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-secure-audit-2027 (restricted)
Jira ticket: SEC-721 (create quick PR with checklist if helpful)

Marissa — please include an HR attestation (signed) that the samples are representative of production practice. Jonas — can you confirm the deprovisioning export includes timestamps and the cloud services column?

Thanks,
Rafael
